name: The Fluffy Multi-Functional Fan Glowstick
description: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by 25% for the next battle. When an Aha Instant takes its first action, CRIT DMG is additionally increased by 25%.
story:
The official glowstick for Fluffy Across the Blue. To stay true to the theme of "the Trailblaze," the manufacturer pushed this glowstick's practicality to its absolute limits. It includes: a glowstick, flashlight, lockpick, plasma cutter, grappling hook, monomolecular combat knife, a complete collection of famous quotes from Fluffy Across the Blue... and more. It's the perfect choice for everyday life, traveling, or committing crimes.

"Breaking news: The Security Bureau is re-evaluating the regulation level of the 'The Fluffy Multi-Functional Fan Glowstick' due to its 'significant potential for danger.'"
